metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Target-level ranking recall over three manifest-reported-positive targets; all targets are positive in this development set.

conclusion.confirmed_project_defect_performance: inconclusive: evaluations were run without reviewed confirmations, so the project-scope count is zero and first-confirmed-defect time is censored
conclusion.risk_grouped_vs_risk_only: algorithmically indistinguishable on this corpus because every structural complexity value is zero and both plans have the same order
conclusion.scope: descriptive backend-candidate/order-throughput pilot on three direct wrappers from one project family; no statistical superiority claim

limitations: The corpus contains only three direct wrappers from one project family and has no independent held-out evaluation set.
All three targets are manifest-reported positives, so target-level Recall@K is K/3 for every ordering and does not discriminate strategies.
These evaluations contain no reviewed confirmations. A zero confirmed-project count means no candidate was promoted by evidence, not that review disproved every candidate.
Four fixed strategies (small-first, warning-first, risk-only, and risk-grouped) share one identical order; all structural scores are zero.
Wall-clock measurements include subprocess startup and are reported descriptively from seven repetitions.
